chapter: 搜决神鬼章第七十四附总论(八宫、五行、六神)
chapter_en: Chapter 74, appended general discourse (eight palaces, five phases, six spirits)

units.chapter: 搜决神鬼章第七十四·附总论之一:八宫值鬼诀
units.chapter_en: Chapter 74, appended general discourse 1: ghosts by the eight palaces
units.title: 总论八宫值鬼诀(上)：鬼发乾宫是西北寺观庙内神司、旧许天灯香愿经卷斗斋、已故父辈老魂、头风鬼；坎宫是北方水路神司、家内中男、耳聋溺死之魂，坎在外三爻又为北斗、加玄武作玄天上帝；艮宫是东北土神五圣山神土地、少男、臂疮手折指烂鼻鬼；震宫是东方九天（雷祀大帝）、三茅东岳树神、长男、杖伤折足驾舟鬼

rule.yi: 官鬼发动，看它落在哪一宫，就知道是哪一路的神鬼。乾宫：西北方来，是误犯了寺观或庙里的神司，或者旧时许下的天灯、香愿、经卷、斗斋这一类愿，是已经去世的父辈和年老过世的人的魂，是头风的鬼。坎宫：祸在北方，是水路的神司，还有家里的中男在作耗，也有耳聋的鬼、溺死的魂；坎在外三爻时又是北斗，再加玄武也当作玄天上帝。艮宫：东北方来，是冒犯了土神、五圣、山神、土地，也有家里的少男，以及臂上生疮、手折、指烂、烂鼻的鬼。震宫：祸在东方，宜向九天（雷祀大帝）叩祷，又犯三茅真君、东岳尊神和树头的神灵，也有家里的长男作祟，或是天嗔，或是被打死兼折足、驾舟的鬼。
rule.en: When the Pressure line moves, look at which palace it falls in, to know which kind of god or ghost it is. Qian: it comes from the northwest, and one has wrongly offended a temple or abbey or the gods and offices within a temple, or an old vow of a heaven lamp, incense, scriptures or a Dipper fast; it is the soul of a departed father or of an aged person who has died, the ghost of head-wind (chronic headache). Kan: the misfortune lies in the north; it is the gods and offices of the waterways, with the middle son of the household making trouble, and also ghosts of the deaf and souls of the drowned; when Kan is in the outer three lines it is also the Northern Dipper, and with the Dark Tortoise added it is also counted as the Supreme Emperor of the Mysterious Heaven. Gen: it comes from the northeast, offending the Earth spirit, the Five Sages, the Mountain God and the Earth God, and there is also the youngest son of the household and ghosts of arm sores, broken hands, rotten fingers and rotten noses. Zhen: the misfortune lies in the east, and it is fitting to pray to the Nine Heavens (the Great Emperor of the Thunder Rites); it also offends the True Lord of the Three Mao, the honoured god of the Eastern Peak and the sacred spirits of the treetops, and there is the eldest son as haunting, or heaven's wrath, or ghosts beaten to death, with broken legs, or who piloted boats.

zh: 旧许上苍素原或天灯、香愿、经卷、斗齐之类，
yi: 鬼在乾宫发动：是庙里的神；
缘由从西北方来；
是误犯了寺观，或者庙里的神司；
是旧时许下的上天的素愿，或者天灯、香愿、经卷、斗斋这一类；
是已经去世的父亲，和年老过世的人的魂；
是头风的鬼。
en: The ghost moves in the Qian palace: a god within a temple;
the cause comes from the northwest;
one has wrongly offended a temple, an abbey, or the gods and offices within a temple;
an old vow to High Heaven, a vegetarian vow, or the likes of a heaven lamp, an incense vow, scriptures or a Dipper fast;
the soul of a departed father, and of the aged who have died;
the ghost of head-wind (chronic headache).

yi: 坎宫的鬼发动，从北方来；
水部的神司，一定是作灾的；
溺死的、耳聋的，一起来扰害；
家里的中男在作耗，哪里能和顺呢。
en: When the ghost moves in the Kan palace it comes from the north;
the gods and offices of the water department are sure to make calamity;
the drowned and the deaf together trouble and harm;
with the middle son making trouble, how could there be harmony?

zh: 水路神司并家内中男作耗，
亦有耳聋之鬼、瀹死之魂。
又加玄武亦作玄天上帝。
yi: 坎宫鬼动，
祸在北方，
是水路的神司，和家里的中男在作耗；
也有耳聋的鬼、溺死的魂。
坎在外三爻，又是北斗，
再加上玄武，也当作玄天上帝。
en: When the ghost moves in the Kan palace,
the misfortune lies in the north;
the gods and offices of the waterways, together with the middle son of the household, make trouble;
there are also ghosts of the deaf and souls of the drowned.
Kan in the outer three lines is also the Northern Dipper,
and with the Dark Tortoise added it is also counted as the Supreme Emperor of the Mysterious Heaven.

yi: 艮卦官鬼兴动，方位是东北；
山神、五圣和家里的少男是所涉及的；
地氏、土府在那个方位上被冒犯；
手指都成了疮，还有烂了鼻子的亡魂。
en: When the Pressure line rises in the Gen hexagram, it is the northeast;
the Mountain God, the Five Sages and the youngest son are the ones concerned;
the Earth clans and the Earth Mansion are offended in that corner of the compass;
hands and fingers all turn to sores, and there are the dead with rotten noses.

zh: 冒犯土神、五圣并山神、土地为殃，
亦有家内少男及臂疮手折指烂鼻等鬼。
yi: 艮宫鬼动，
从东北方来；
是冒犯了土神、五圣，和山神、土地，才成了祸殃；
也有家里的少男，以及臂上生疮、手折、指烂、烂鼻这类的鬼。
en: When the ghost moves in the Gen palace,
it comes from the northeast;
offending the Earth spirit, the Five Sages, the Mountain God and the Earth God brings the calamity;
there are also the youngest son of the household and ghosts of arm sores, broken hands, rotten fingers, rotten noses and the like.

yi: 震宫的鬼在东方，冒犯了九天；
三茅、东岳、树神被冒犯；
被棍棒打伤的魂、船上的鬼；
折了脚的魂，是家里的长男。
en: A Zhen ghost is in the east and offends the Nine Heavens;
the Three Mao, the Eastern Peak and the tree god are offended;
the soul wounded by the rod, the ghost in the boat;
the soul with a broken leg is the eldest son.

zh: 又犯三茅真君及东岳尊神、及树头神圣，
亦有长男为祟、或天嗔、或责毙兼折足、驾舟等鬼。
yi: 震宫鬼动，
祸在东方，
宜向九天叩祷。
所谓九天，
就是雷祀大帝，
也就是王枢经了。
又冒犯三茅真君和东岳尊神，以及树头的神灵，
也有家里的长男作祟，或是天嗔，或是被打死兼折了脚、驾船这类的鬼。
en: When the ghost moves in the Zhen palace,
the misfortune lies in the east;
it is fitting to pray to the Nine Heavens.
The Nine Heavens are
the Great Emperor of the Thunder Rites,
that is, the Wangshu Scripture (the text has 'Wangshu', probably for 'Yushu').
It also offends the True Lord of the Three Mao, the honoured god of the Eastern Peak and the sacred spirits of the treetops,
and there is also the eldest son as haunting, or heaven's wrath, or ghosts beaten to death, with broken legs, who piloted boats and the like.

note.yi: 这一段是书里「总论」的头一段（编号「之一」），接在搜决神鬼章的结语（LY.ILL.EL.43）之后：按官鬼所在的宫来认神鬼，和易冒的八宫（LY.ILL.YM.57）、黄金策的八宫（LY.ILL.HJC.95）、本章前面「鬼临何卦何爻」（LY.ILL.EL.35）是同一类办法，只是这里每宫先给一首歌诀、再给一段解说，并且直接列出民间的具体神名。乾宫这里只有解说、没有歌诀。细目上，易林补遗大体把黄金策和易冒两套并列写了进去：乾用黄金策的天灯斗愿，震既有易冒的九天、折足，又有黄金策的树神、杖死，艮和易冒一样是山神、少男。「椿庭」指父亲（「萱堂」指母亲，见下一条）；「头风」是久治不愈的头痛；「斗齐」按上下文读作「斗斋」，「素原」读作「素愿」——这本书里「愿」常写作「原」（「香原」「香愿」并见）；「三茅」是道教茅山的三位茅君；「王枢经」疑是「玉枢经」（本章后面「解禳通用法」里写的就是「玉枢经」）；「瀹死」的「瀹」本义是煮，这里按上下句（「溺死」）读作溺死；「地氏」没有解释，按字面译；「手指皆为疮烂鼻亡」文字含混，对着下面解说「臂疮手折指烂鼻等鬼」译。「坎在外三爻」按字面译，指坎在外面三爻（外卦）。这一段里神、鬼、星煞的名字，是吴地的民间神祇和星煞，书里没有解释，这里按字面译或音译，不作认定。
note.en: This is the first section of the book's appended 'general discourse' (numbered 'one'), coming after the closing passage of the 'searching out ghosts and spirits' chapter (LY.ILL.EL.43): it recognises the god or ghost by the palace the Pressure line is in. It is the same kind of method as the Yi Mao's eight palaces (LY.ILL.YM.57), the Huangjin Ce's eight palaces (LY.ILL.HJC.95) and this chapter's earlier 'which trigram and which line the ghost is in' (LY.ILL.EL.35), except that here each palace gets a verse first and then a commentary, and popular names of particular gods are listed outright. For Qian there is only the commentary and no verse. In detail, the Yilin Buyi in the main sets the two systems, the Huangjin Ce's and the Yi Mao's, side by side: Qian uses the Huangjin Ce's heaven lamp and Dipper vow, Zhen has both the Yi Mao's Nine Heavens and broken leg and the Huangjin Ce's tree spirit and death by the rod, and Gen agrees with the Yi Mao in the Mountain God and the youngest son. 'Chun ting' (the toon-tree courtyard) means the father (the 'Xuan hall' means the mother, see the next entry); 'head-wind' is a headache that does not go away; 'dou qi' is read as 'dou zhai' (a fast of the Dipper) from the context, and the 'yuan' of 'su yuan' (a vegetarian vow) is the character for 'source', which this book often writes for the character for 'vow' (both forms of 'incense vow' occur); the 'Three Mao' are the three Mao lords of the Daoist Mount Mao; 'Wangshu Scripture' is probably the 'Yushu Scripture' (the Jade Pivot Scripture), which is the name written in this chapter's later 'general methods of exorcism'; the 'yue' in 'yue si' properly means to boil, and is read here as drowned from the neighbouring line ('drowned'); 'Earth clans' has no explanation and is rendered literally; the verse 'hands and fingers all turn to sores, and the dead with rotten noses' is loose in wording and is translated against the commentary below, 'ghosts of arm sores, broken hands, rotten fingers and rotten noses'. 'Kan in the outer three lines' is rendered literally and means Kan in the outer three lines (the outer trigram). Names of gods, spirits and stars in this passage are given by transliteration or plain rendering; they are cults and stars of the Wu region that the book does not explain, and none is identified here beyond what the book says.

units.chapter: 搜决神鬼章第七十四·附总论之一:八宫值鬼诀
units.chapter_en: Chapter 74, appended general discourse 1: ghosts by the eight palaces
units.title: 总论八宫值鬼诀(下)：鬼发巽宫是东南镇海施相公、花园树木神道、长女、缢死疯疾腿折腰跎鬼；离宫是南方火部诸神（南斗六司、火德星君、五显灵官、灶神）、中女、目疾焚烧鬼；坤宫是西南土皇、坟墓、已故母亲老妇、虚黄鼓胀鬼；兑宫是正西佛天口许、伤神、少女、缺唇师巫鬼，加朱雀动是自己罚誓或他人咒咀天曹

rule.yi: 巽宫：病患在东南，是冒犯了镇海的施相公、花园树木的神道，以及长女和上吊死的、疯疾的、腿折的、驼背的鬼。离宫：祸从南方起，是火部的诸神——南斗六司、火德星君、五显灵官、香头灶神这一类，还有中女以及眼盲、火烧这类的鬼，要赶紧酬愿、焚香。坤宫：西南方来，是冒犯了土皇使人不安，或者是坟墓上的缘故，和已故的母亲、年老的妇人，以及面色虚黄、腹胀如鼓的鬼。兑宫：祸落在正西，是许过佛、天的愿，也犯了伤神和少女，以及缺唇的、师巫这类的鬼；再加朱雀发动，不是自己发过誓、赌过咒，就是别人在天曹那里咒了他。
rule.en: Xun: the illness lies in the southeast, and it is an offence against Lord Shi who pacifies the sea, the spirits of garden trees, and the eldest daughter and ghosts of the hanged, of madness, of broken legs and of bent backs. Li: the misfortune rises in the south, and it is the gods of the Fire Department, the likes of the Six Departments of the Southern Dipper, the Fire Virtue Star Lord, the Five Manifest Spirit Officials and the incense head and Kitchen God, and also the middle daughter and ghosts of blindness and burning, and the vow should be redeemed quickly and incense burned. Kun: it comes from the southwest, and it is an offence against the Earth Emperor that brings unrest, or a matter of graves, together with the late mother and old women and ghosts of pale-yellow emptiness and drum-like swelling. Dui: the misfortune stains the due west, and it is a vow made to Buddha or Heaven, and it also offends the injuring spirit and the youngest daughter and ghosts of the harelipped, teachers and shamans; and if the Vermilion Bird moves too, then if it is not one's own sworn oath it is someone else cursing at the Heavenly Bureau.

yi: 巽主东南方，是尊贵的施相公；
园林里的神道也会生气；
是路上冲撞、腿折了、腰驼了的鬼；
上吊死的、麻风的、长女的魂。
en: Xun governs the southeast, the honoured Minister Shi;
the spirits of the gardens and groves also grow angry;
the ghost of the road clash, the broken leg and the bent back;
the soul of one hanged, of leprosy, of an eldest daughter.

zh: 有干镇海施相公、花园树木神道、并长女及缢死、疯疾腿折腰跎等鬼。
yi: 巽宫鬼动，
病患在东南；
是冒犯了镇海的施相公、花园树木的神道，以及长女和上吊死的、疯疾的、腿折的、腰驼的这类鬼。
en: When the ghost moves in the Xun palace,
the illness lies in the southeast;
it is an offence against Minister Shi who pacifies the sea, the spirits of garden trees, and the eldest daughter and ghosts of the hanged, of madness, of broken legs and of bent backs.

zh: 起南方火部诸神司命王、目疾焚烧亡二鬼、速酬中女及焚香。
yi: 离宫的鬼发动，
祸从南方起：火部的诸神、司命王，眼病和火烧死的两种鬼，要赶紧酬愿给中女、并且焚香。
en: When the ghost moves in the Li palace,

it rises from the south: the gods of the Fire Department, the Director of Fate the King, the two ghosts of eye disease and of burning to death, and the vow should be repaid quickly for the middle daughter and incense burned.

zh: 南斗六司、火德星君、五显灵官、香头灶神之类，
更有中女并眼盲火烧之类。
yi: 离宫鬼动，
南方的神有所冒犯；
是南斗六司、火德星君、五显灵官、香头灶神这一类；
更有中女，以及眼盲、火烧这类。
en: When the ghost moves in the Li palace,
there is an offence against a god in the south;
the likes of the Six Departments of the Southern Dipper, the Fire Virtue Star Lord, the Five Manifest Spirit Officials, the incense head and the Kitchen God;
and further the middle daughter and the likes of blindness and burning.

zh: 坤鬼西南犯土皇、或因坟墓有相妨。
脸黄腹胀身亡鬼老妪他魂及母娘。
yi: 坤宫的鬼在西南，冒犯了土皇，或者因为坟墓有妨碍。
脸黄腹胀而死的鬼、年老妇人和别的魂，以及母亲。
en: A Kun ghost in the southwest offends the Earth Emperor, or there is obstruction from graves.
Ghosts who died with a yellow face and swollen belly, the soul of an old woman and others, and the mother.

zh: 西南犯土不宁、或坟墓上并已故萱堂及老阴人、兼虚黄鼓胀之鬼。
yi: 坤宫鬼动，
西南方冒犯了土，不得安宁，或是坟墓上的事，以及已故的母亲、年老的妇人，兼有虚黄鼓胀的鬼。
en: When the ghost moves in the Kun palace,

in the southwest an offence against the Earth brings unrest, or it is a matter of graves, and the late mother (the Xuan hall) and old women, together with the ghost of pale-yellow emptiness and drum-like swelling.

yi: 兑卦的鬼在西方，
缺唇的、祝巫、少女一起来伤人；
向神佛、上天口头许下的愿，何曾还过；
更有仇家的咒诅中在心上。
en: A ghost in the Dui hexagram, in the west;
the harelipped, the invokers and shamans, and the youngest daughter all do harm together;
as for the vows spoken to gods, Buddhas and Heaven, when were they ever redeemed;
and moreover the curses of enemy households strike at the heart.

zh: 亦犯伤神并少女、兼缺唇师巫等鬼。
yi: 兑宫鬼动，
祸染正西；
是许过佛、天这一类的愿；
也犯了伤神和少女，兼有缺唇的、师巫这类的鬼。
再加朱雀发动，
如果不是自己罚咒发誓的心，
就是别人在天曹面前咒诅。
en: When the ghost moves in the Dui palace,
the misfortune stains the due west;
vows made to Buddha or Heaven and the like;
it also offends the injuring spirit and the youngest daughter, together with ghosts such as the harelipped, teachers and shamans.
With the Vermilion Bird moving as well,
if it is not one's own heart of swearing an oath,
it is someone else cursing before the Heavenly Bureau.

note.yi: 这是「总论八宫值鬼诀」的下半（巽、离、坤、兑），体例同上一条（LY.ILL.EL.44）。「路冲」是路上冲撞；「腰跎」按字面译作弯腰，疑是「腰驼」；「麻疯」即麻风。离宫的歌诀「离家鬼发」的「家」按上下文是「宫」；它只有两个分句，一半歌诀一半解说，这里都当歌诀译。解说里「神撤南方有犯」的「撤」字费解，按「南方的神有所冒犯」的大意译；「香头灶神」按字面译作「香头、灶神」，「香头」可能是管香火的人，也可能是香火神，书里没有解释。「萱堂」是母亲（与上一条的「椿庭」相对）；「虚黄鼓胀」是面色萎黄、腹胀如鼓一类的病，和本章「土鬼」（LY.ILL.EL.34）的「膨胀虚黄」相同。兑宫最后「加朱雀动」是说朱雀也动：朱雀主口舌，所以是罚咒发誓一类的口舌事，不是自己发过誓，就是别人在天曹面前咒过他；和黄金策「朱雀咒诅口舌」（LY.ILL.HJC.96）、易冒「朱雀离神词讼囹圄冤鬼」（LY.ILL.YM.59）同一路。巽宫的「缢死、疯疾」是黄金策的巽（LY.ILL.HJC.95），「镇海、园林、长女」是易冒的巽（LY.ILL.YM.57），这里两边都收。这一段里神、鬼、星煞的名字，是吴地的民间神祇和星煞，书里没有解释，这里按字面译或音译，不作认定。
note.en: This is the second half of the 'general discourse on the eight palaces' (Xun, Li, Kun, Dui), in the same form as the previous entry (LY.ILL.EL.44). 'Lu chong' is a clash on the road; 'yao tuo' is translated literally as a bent waist and is probably 'yao tuo' meaning hunchback; 'ma feng' is leprosy. In the Li verse 'Li jia gui fa' the 'jia' (house) is 'palace' from the context; it has only two clauses, half verse and half commentary, and both are translated as verse here. In the commentary the 'che' in 'shen che nan fang you fan' is hard to understand, and is translated in the general sense 'there is an offence against a god in the south'; 'xiang tou zao shen' is translated literally as 'the incense head and the Kitchen God', and the 'incense head' may be a keeper of the incense fire or an incense spirit, which the book does not explain. The 'Xuan hall' is the mother (as opposed to the 'Chun ting' of the previous entry); 'pale-yellow emptiness and drum-like swelling' is an illness of a sallow face and a belly swollen like a drum, the same as the 'swelling and pale-yellow emptiness' of this chapter's 'Earth ghost' (LY.ILL.EL.34). The last 'with the Vermilion Bird moving' in Dui means the Vermilion Bird also moves: the Vermilion Bird governs the mouth and tongue, so it is a matter of oaths and curses, and if it is not one's own oath it is another's curse before the Heavenly Bureau; it is on the same path as the Huangjin Ce's 'the Vermilion Bird is curses and quarrels' (LY.ILL.HJC.96) and the Yi Mao's 'the Vermilion Bird is the spirit of Li, lawsuits and the grievous ghost of prison' (LY.ILL.YM.59). The Xun's 'hanged and madness' is the Huangjin Ce's Xun (LY.ILL.HJC.95) and 'pacifying the sea, gardens and groves and the eldest daughter' is the Yi Mao's Xun (LY.ILL.YM.57); here both are taken in. Names of gods, spirits and stars in this passage are given by transliteration or plain rendering; they are cults and stars of the Wu region that the book does not explain, and none is identified here beyond what the book says.

units.chapter: 搜决神鬼章第七十四·附总论之二:五行值鬼诀
units.chapter_en: Chapter 74, appended general discourse 2: ghosts by the five phases
units.title: 总论五行值鬼诀：鬼值金爻是西伤（五道）总管丧神七煞、张相（六五相公）金神金元七总管寺内金刚自刎鬼锁条之愿、叶神（九卓）钟师（钟将军）武安王（关公）；木爻是茶延枷锁船神草野家堂萧公（五圣）东岳树神山神九良星煞悬梁（缢死）鬼；水爻是观音三官北斗龙王祠山大帝金龙四大王水仙杜氏河太曹三施宋二相晏公井泉童子徐大将军河伯水官溺死魂；火爻是赵玄坛五福五显灵官火德星君三煞天灯香愿南堂五圣灶神焚烧鬼；土爻是城隍社庙神五方贤圣土皇土地太岁螣蛇皮肠大王瘟疫鬼；此论五行所属，仍须把六兽入官细看、轻重同看，不可胡判

rule.yi: 官鬼落在哪一行的爻上，就是哪一路的神鬼。金爻：是煞，还有西伤（就是五道）；总管、丧神、七煞；张相（就是六五相公）和金神七煞、金元七总管、寺里的金刚、自刎的鬼、锁条的愿；叶神（就是九卓）、钟师（就是钟将军）、武安王（就是关公）。木爻：茶延、枷锁、船神、草野、家堂、萧公（就是五圣）、东岳、树神、山神、九良星煞，和悬梁的鬼（就是上吊死的鬼）。水爻：观音、三官、北斗、龙王、祠山大帝、金龙四大王、水仙、杜氏夫人、河太、曹三、施相公、宋相公、晏公、坑厕的主、井泉童子、徐大将军、河伯水官，和溺死的魂。火爻：赵玄坛、五福大神、五显灵官、火德星君、三煞、天灯香愿、南堂五圣、灶神，和被火烧死的鬼。土爻：城隍、社庙里的神、五方贤圣、土皇、土地、太岁、螣蛇、皮肠大王，和瘟疫鬼。这里只是论五行各属哪些神，还要再把六兽放进官鬼里去寻，轻重也照这样比较，千万不要随口乱判是哪一位鬼神。
rule.en: The Pressure line on a line of a given phase gives that kind of god or ghost. A Metal line: a killing star, and further the Western Injury (the Five Roads); the Chief Official, the mourning spirits, the Seven Killings; Lord Zhang (Lord Liuwu) with the Golden Spirit and the Seven Killings, the Chief Official Jin Yuanqi, the vajra guardians in temples, ghosts who cut their own throats, and the vow of the chain; the Leaf God (Jiuzhuo), Master Zhong (General Zhong) and the King of Martial Peace (Guan Gong). A Wood line: the Tea Feast, the cangue and fetters, the boat god, the wilds, the household shrine, Lord Xiao (the Five Sages), the Eastern Peak, the tree god, the Mountain God and the Nine Good Stars, and the ghost of hanging from a beam (that is, one who hanged himself). A Water line: Guanyin, the Three Officials, the Northern Dipper, the Dragon King, the Great Emperor of Ci Mountain, the Golden Dragon Fourth Great King, the Water Immortal, Lady Du, He Tai, Cao San, Minister Shi, Minister Song, Lord Yan, the master of pit and privy, the youth of the well and spring, General Xu, the River Count and the water officials, and the souls of the drowned. A Fire line: Zhao Xuantan, the Great God of the Five Blessings, the Five Manifest Spirit Officials, the Fire Virtue Star Lord, the Three Killings, the heaven lamp and incense vow, the Five Sages of the Southern Hall, the Kitchen God, and ghosts burned to death. An Earth line: the City God, the gods of shrines and temples, the sages of the five quarters, the Earth Emperor, the Earth God, Tai Sui, the Coiling Snake, the Great King Pichang, and ghosts of epidemic. This only discusses which gods belong to which phase; one must further bring the six beasts into the Pressure line to search, weigh the light and the heavy in the same way, and on no account judge which ghost or god it is by idle talk.

yi: 金爻上值鬼，是冒犯了西伤；
总管、丧神、七煞来妨碍；
张相、金刚、刀下的鬼；
叶神、钟师、武安王。
en: A Metal line holding the ghost offends the Western Injury;
the Chief Official, the mourning spirits and the Seven Killings obstruct;
Lord Zhang, the vajra guardian, the ghost beneath the blade;
the Leaf God, Master Zhong and the King of Martial Peace.

zh: 鬼值金爻为煞，更有西伤，即五道也。
张相即六五相公并金神七煞、金元七总管及寺内金刚、自刎之鬼，锁条之愿。
yi: 鬼值金爻是煞，更有西伤，就是五道。
叶神就是九卓。
钟师就是钟将军。
武安王就是关公。
张相就是六五相公，和金神七煞、金元七总管以及寺里的金刚、自刎的鬼、锁条的愿。
en: A ghost on a Metal line is a killing star, and further there is the Western Injury, which is the Five Roads.
The Leaf God is Jiuzhuo.
Master Zhong is General Zhong.
The King of Martial Peace is Guan Gong.

Lord Zhang is Lord Liuwu, together with the Golden Spirit and the Seven Killings, the Chief Official Jin Yuanqi and the vajra guardians in temples, ghosts who cut their own throats, and the vow of the chain.

zh: 茶廷枷锁当船神、草野及家堂萧公东岳、悬梁鬼、树圣山神共九良。
yi: 木爻上的鬼：
茶延、枷锁，当值的是船神；草野和家堂、萧公、东岳、悬梁的鬼、树圣、山神，共是九良。
en: A Wood ghost:

the Tea Feast and the cangue and fetters, with the boat god in charge; the wilds and the household shrine, Lord Xiao, the Eastern Peak, the ghost who hanged from a beam, the Tree Sage and the Mountain God, together the Nine Good Stars.

zh: 鬼值木爻为茶延、草野家堂、东岳树神、山神、舟中神、枷锁原心九良星煞。
yi: 鬼值木爻，是茶延、草野家堂、东岳树神、山神、船里的神、枷锁愿心、九良星煞。
萧公就是五圣。
悬梁就是上吊死的鬼。
en: A ghost on a Wood line is the Tea Feast, the wilds and household shrine, the Eastern Peak and the tree god, the Mountain God, the god of the boat, the vow of the cangue and fetters, and the Nine Good Stars.
Lord Xiao is the Five Sages.
Hanging from a beam is the ghost of one who hanged himself.

zh: 北斗又三元祠山杜氏金龙四河太曹堂并水仙、施相晏公兼宋相落水亡灵坑井泉。
yi: 水爻上的鬼：
观音、兴武、天龙王；
北斗，还有三元、祠山、杜氏、金龙四大王、河太曹堂，和水仙；施相公、晏公，兼有宋相公、落水的亡灵、坑、井、泉。
en: A Water ghost:
Guanyin, Xingwu, the Heavenly Dragon King;

the Northern Dipper, also the Three Primes, Ci Mountain, Lady Du, the Golden Dragon Fourth Great King, He Tai and the Cao Hall together with the Water Immortal; Minister Shi and Lord Yan together with Minister Song, the dead souls fallen in water, the pit, the well and the spring.

zh: 为观世音、三官驿帝、北斗龙王、祠山大帝、金龙四大王、水仙五圣、杜氏夫人、河太曹三、施相公、宋相公、晏公坑厕主、井泉童子、徐大将军、河伯水官并瀹死亡魂。
yi: 鬼值水爻，
是观世音、三官驿帝、北斗龙王、祠山大帝、金龙四大王、水仙五圣、杜氏夫人、河太曹三、施相公、宋相公、晏公、坑厕的主、井泉的童子、徐大将军、河伯水官，和溺死的亡魂。
en: A ghost on a Water line

is Guanshiyin, the Three Officials and the Emperor of the Post, the Northern Dipper and the Dragon King, the Great Emperor of Ci Mountain, the Golden Dragon Fourth Great King, the Water Immortal and the Five Sages, Lady Du, He Tai and Cao San, Minister Shi, Minister Song, Lord Yan, the master of pit and privy, the youth of the well and spring, General Xu, the River Count and the water officials, together with the souls of the drowned.

zh: 玄坛五福祠南堂五头灶、东厨萧堂香原焚烧鬼，
yi: 火爻上的鬼：
玄坛、五福祠、南堂、五头灶，东厨、萧堂、香愿、烧死的鬼；
荧惑星君和三煞司。
en: A Fire ghost:
the Dark Altar, the shrine of the Five Blessings, the Southern Hall, the five-headed stove, the Eastern Kitchen, the Xiao Hall, the incense vow, the ghost burned to death;
the Star Lord Yinghuo and the offices of the Three Killings.

zh: 为赵玄坛、五福大神、五显灵官、火德星君、银神三煞、天灯香愿，
南堂五圣、灶神并火烧鬼。
yi: 鬼值火爻，
是赵玄坛、五福大神、五显灵官、火德星君、银神三煞、天灯香愿，
南堂五圣、灶神，和火烧死的鬼。
en: A ghost on a Fire line
is Zhao Xuantan, the Great God of the Five Blessings, the Five Manifest Spirit Officials, the Fire Virtue Star Lord, the Silver Spirit and the Three Killings, the heaven lamp and incense vow,
the Five Sages of the Southern Hall and the Kitchen God, together with ghosts burned to death.

zh: 城隍社庙神、五方贤圣上皇尊、皮肠大王瘟疫鬼、土地螣蛇太岁君。
yi: 土爻上的鬼：
城隍、社庙的神、五方贤圣和尊贵的上皇、皮肠大王和瘟疫鬼、土地、螣蛇、太岁君。
en: An Earth ghost:

the City God, the god of the earth-altar shrine, the sages of the five quarters and the honoured Supreme Sovereign, the Great King Pichang and the ghost of epidemic, the Earth God, the Coiling Snake and Lord Tai Sui.

zh: 为城隍土壳神祠庙中神道、五方贤圣、土皇土地太岁、螣蛇、皮肠大王并瘟疫鬼。
yi: 鬼值土爻，
是城隍、土壳神、祠庙中的神道、五方贤圣、土皇土地太岁、螣蛇、皮肠大王，和瘟疫鬼。
这里论的是五行各属哪些神，
还要再把六兽放进官鬼里去寻，
轻重也照这样比较来看，
千万不要随口乱判鬼神。
en: A ghost on an Earth line

is the City God, the earth-husk spirits, the gods within shrines and temples, the sages of the five quarters, the Earth Emperor, the Earth God and Tai Sui, the Coiling Snake, the Great King Pichang, and ghosts of epidemic.
This discusses which gods belong to each of the five phases;
one must further bring the six beasts into the Pressure line to search;
weigh the light and the heavy in the same way;
on no account judge ghosts and gods by idle talk.

note.yi: 这是「总论」的第二段（编号「之二」）：把官鬼所在的五行各配一串神名。本章前面（LY.ILL.EL.30 到 EL.34）已经按五行配六兽逐个写过一遍，这里是把神名压成一张速查表；末了一句「还将六兽入官寻」就是指回那里——先看五行，再看六兽，两样合起来才断，不能只凭一样。名字上的几处存疑：「金罡」按下面解说的「寺内金刚」读作金刚（护法），这里音译带出；「茶廷」和解说的「茶延」是同一个，按「茶延」（Tea Feast，LY.ILL.EL.39 译法）处理；「兴武」疑是「真武」（易隐的水鬼名单是「观音真武三官」，LY.ILL.YY.28，顺序和这里一致），这里按原字音译；「河太曹堂」的「堂」和解说的「曹三」不一致，两处都按原文译；「三官驿帝」的「驿帝」费解，可能是「三官大帝」之误，这里按字面译；「土壳神」疑是「土谷神」（易隐的土鬼名单写「城隍土谷太岁皮场大王」，LY.ILL.YY.28），「皮肠大王」易隐写作「皮场大王」，这里都按原字译；「鬼值金爻为煞」的「煞」是杀气、凶星的统称。「瀹死」同上一条，读作溺死。「五道」「九卓」「钟将军」「关公」「六五相公」是解说自己给的对应，这里照抄，不另作认定。这一段里神、鬼、星煞的名字，是吴地的民间神祇和星煞，书里没有解释，这里按字面译或音译，不作认定。
note.en: This is the second section of the 'general discourse' (numbered 'two'): each phase the Pressure line falls in is matched with a string of divine names. Earlier in this chapter (LY.ILL.EL.30 to EL.34) the phases were matched with the six beasts one by one, and here the names are compressed into a quick-reference table; the last sentence, 'then bring the six beasts into the Pressure line to search', points back there: first look at the phase, then at the beast, and judge only with the two together, never from one alone. Doubts about a few names: 'Jingang' (with an unusual second character) is read as the vajra guardian from the 'vajra guardians in temples' in the commentary below and is transliterated; 'cha ting' and the commentary's 'cha yan' are the same, and are handled as 'Tea Feast' (as translated in LY.ILL.EL.39); 'Xingwu' is probably 'Zhenwu' (the Yi Yin's Water ghost list is 'Guanyin, Zhenwu, the Three Officials', LY.ILL.YY.28, in the same order as here), and is transliterated as written; the 'tang' in 'He Tai Cao Tang' does not agree with the commentary's 'Cao San' and both are translated as written; the 'yi di' in 'the Three Officials and the Emperor of the Post' is hard to understand and may be a slip for 'the Three Officials the Great Emperors', and is translated literally; 'earth-husk spirits' is probably 'earth-and-grain spirits' (the Yi Yin's Earth ghost list reads 'the City God, the Earth-and-Grain, Tai Sui, the Great King Pichang', LY.ILL.YY.28), and the Yi Yin writes 'Pichang' with a different character for 'chang'; all are translated as written; the 'sha' in 'a ghost on a Metal line is a killing star' is the general term for a killing air or ill-omened star. 'Yue si' is as in the previous entries, read as drowned. The correspondences 'Five Roads', 'Jiuzhuo', 'General Zhong', 'Guan Gong' and 'Lord Liuwu' are given by the commentary itself and are copied here, without further identification. Names of gods, spirits and stars in this passage are given by transliteration or plain rendering; they are cults and stars of the Wu region that the book does not explain, and none is identified here beyond what the book says.

units.chapter: 搜决神鬼章第七十四·附总论之三:六神值诀
units.chapter_en: Chapter 74, appended general discourse 3: the six spirits
units.title: 总论六神值诀：鬼值青龙是东岳家堂茶筵花煞五圣龙王三官五路及枷锁愿心产亡鬼；朱雀是城隍草野总管天曹华光（五显灵官）广灵侯（南堂陆太君）司令（灶神）及旧欠愿心牢中鬼；勾陈是土皇五方贤圣跌死鬼；螣蛇是妖怪土地里社之神产亡缢死二鬼；白虎是伤司五道丧煞赵玄坛金神（七煞）叶神（九卓）刀伤虎伤鬼；玄武是圣帝曹三河太伏尸坑厕井泉童子杜氏夫人采山（草野三郎）溺死窃盗二鬼；定六神诸位仍须八卦五行排、看清何爻临鬼，莫累人虚费财

rule.yi: 鬼值青龙：是东岳、家堂、茶筵、花煞、五圣、龙王、三官大帝、五路尊神，以及枷锁愿心、产亡的鬼。鬼值朱雀：是城隍、草野总管、天曹、华光（就是五显灵官）、广灵侯（就是南堂陆太君）、司令（就是灶神），以及旧欠愿心、牢里的鬼。鬼值勾陈：是土皇和五方贤圣，以及跌死的鬼。鬼值螣蛇：是妖怪，并且作犯，又是土、当方的土地、里社之神，以及产亡、缢死两种鬼。鬼值白虎：是伤司、五道、丧煞，赵玄坛和金神就是七煞，叶神就是九卓，以及刀伤、虎伤的鬼。鬼值玄武：是圣帝、曹三、河太、伏尸、坑厕、土井泉童子、杜氏夫人，采山就是草野三郎，以及溺死、偷盗两种鬼。要定下六神各是哪一位圣，还必须靠八卦和五行来排，哪一爻临在鬼上要看清楚，不要连累人白白花钱。
rule.en: The Pressure line on the Azure Dragon: the Eastern Peak, the household shrine, the Tea Feast, the Flower Killing, the Five Sages, the Dragon King, the Three Officials the Great Emperors and the honoured god of the Five Roads, together with ghosts of the cangue-and-fetters vow and of death in childbirth. On the Vermilion Bird: the City God, the Chief Official of the wilds, the Heavenly Bureau, Huaguang (the Five Manifest Spirit Officials), the Marquis Guangling (Lady Lu of the Southern Hall), the Director (the Kitchen God), together with ghosts of old owed vows and of the prison. On Hook Earth: the Earth Emperor and the sages of the five quarters, and the ghost of one who died by a fall. On the Coiling Snake: monsters, and it makes an offence; also the earth, the Earth God of the local quarter, the god of the village altar, and the two ghosts of death in childbirth and of hanging. On the White Tiger: the Injuring Office, the Five Roads, the Mourning Killing; Zhao Xuantan and the Golden Spirit are the Seven Killings; the Leaf God is Jiuzhuo; together with ghosts of knife wounds and tiger wounds. On the Dark Tortoise: the Holy Emperor, Cao San, He Tai, the buried corpse, the pit and privy, the earth, the youth of the well and spring, Lady Du; the Mountain Gatherer is the Third Lord of the wilds; together with the two ghosts of drowning and of theft. To fix which sage each of the six spirits is, one must still arrange them by the eight trigrams and the five phases, look closely to see which line sits on the ghost, and not burden people with empty spending of money.

yi: 青龙：东岳和家堂；
五福、茶筵、花煞来妨碍；
萧公、五路、花枷之愿；
三官、产妇、海龙王。
en: The Azure Dragon: the Eastern Peak and the household shrine;
the Five Blessings, the Tea Feast and the Flower Killing obstruct;
Lord Xiao, the Five Roads, the vow of flowers and the cangue;
the Three Officials, women who died in childbirth, the Sea Dragon King.

zh: 为东岳、家堂、茶筵、花煞、五圣、龙王、三官大帝、五路尊神，
yi: 鬼值青龙，
是东岳、家堂、茶筵、花煞、五圣、龙王、三官大帝、五路尊神，
以及枷锁愿心、产亡的鬼。
en: A ghost on the Azure Dragon
is the Eastern Peak, the household shrine, the Tea Feast, the Flower Killing, the Five Sages, the Dragon King, the Three Officials the Great Emperors and the honoured god of the Five Roads,
together with ghosts of the cangue-and-fetters vow and of death in childbirth.

yi: 朱雀：城隍、草野来求；
华光、总管、广灵侯；
天曹、司命、牢狱的鬼；
旧时许下的金钱，还没有答谢。
en: The Vermilion Bird: the City God and the wilds come to seek;
Huaguang, the Chief Official, the Marquis Guangling;
the Heavenly Bureau, the Director of Fate, the ghost of prison;
an old promised gift of money not yet repaid.

zh: 为城隍、草野总管天曹华光即五显灵官，
yi: 鬼值朱雀，
是城隍、草野总管、天曹、华光（就是五显灵官），
广灵侯就是南堂陆太君，
司令就是灶神，
以及旧欠愿心、牢里的鬼。
en: A ghost on the Vermilion Bird
is the City God, the Chief Official of the wilds, the Heavenly Bureau, Huaguang (that is, the Five Manifest Spirit Officials);
the Marquis Guangling is Lady Lu of the Southern Hall;
the Director is the Kitchen God;
together with ghosts of old owed vows and of the prison.

yi: 勾陈上值鬼，要细细推详；
必定是冒犯了承天的后土皇；
跌死、伤亡的样子会在身上显现；
止苍的贤圣降下大的灾殃。
en: When Hook Earth holds the ghost, work it out closely;
it surely offends the Sovereign Earth Emperor who receives Heaven;
death by a fall and injury show themselves in the body;
the sages of Zhicang send down great calamity.

yi: 鬼值勾陈，
是土皇和五方贤圣，
以及跌死的鬼。
en: A ghost on Hook Earth
is the Earth Emperor together with the sages of the five quarters,
and ghosts of those who died by a fall.

yi: 螣蛇是妖怪，却临到门上；
作出冒犯当方的皇社之神；
或者断作螣蛇的坟墓之土；
产亡、缢死这两种灵魂。
en: The Coiling Snake is a monster that comes to the door;
it makes an offence against the spirit of the imperial shrine of that quarter;
or it is judged the grave-earth of the Coiling Snake;
the two souls, of death in childbirth and of hanging.

zh: 鬼值螣蛇为妖怪，并作犯上。
又为螣蛇土当方土地里社之神、及产亡、缢死二鬼。
yi: 鬼值螣蛇，是妖怪，并且作犯。
又是螣蛇之土、当方的土地、里社的神，以及产亡、缢死两种鬼。
en: A ghost on the Coiling Snake is a monster, and it makes an offence.
It is also the earth of the Coiling Snake, the Earth God of the local quarter, the god of the village altar, and the two ghosts of death in childbirth and of hanging.

yi: 白虎：西台的大小伤；
金神、五道、叶神的堂；
雌雄两煞、玄坛的将；
刀剑伤身，虎咬而死。
en: The White Tiger: the Western Terrace, the greater and lesser Injuring [Offices];
the Golden Spirit, the Five Roads, the hall of the Leaf God;
the two killings male and female, the general of the Dark Altar;
wounded by knife or sword, dead from a tiger's bite.

zh: 鬼值白虎，为伤司五道丧煞。
赵玄坛金神即七煞也，叶神即九卓也，并刀伤虎伤之鬼。
yi: 鬼值白虎，是伤司、五道、丧煞。
赵玄坛、金神就是七煞，叶神就是九卓，以及刀伤、虎伤的鬼。
en: A ghost on the White Tiger is the Injuring Office, the Five Roads and the Mourning Killing.
Zhao Xuantan and the Golden Spirit are the Seven Killings, the Leaf God is Jiuzhuo, together with ghosts of knife wounds and tiger wounds.

yi: 玄武：采山，同圣帝；
伏尸、坑厕、井神的台；
曹堂、杜氏，再加河太；
溺水、穿窬这两种鬼来了。
en: The Dark Tortoise: the Mountain Gatherer with the Holy Emperor;
the buried corpse, the pit and privy, the well god's terrace;
the Cao Hall and Lady Du, with He Tai added;
the two ghosts, of drowning and of burgling, come.

zh: 为圣帝曹三河太伏尸坑厕土井泉童子、杜氏夫人。
采山即草野三郎、并瀹死窃盗二鬼。
yi: 鬼值玄武，
是圣帝、曹三、河太、伏尸、坑厕、土井泉童子、杜氏夫人。
采山就是草野三郎，以及溺死、偷盗这两种鬼。
en: A ghost on the Dark Tortoise
is the Holy Emperor, Cao San, He Tai, the buried corpse, the pit and privy, the earth, the youth of the well and spring, and Lady Du.
The Mountain Gatherer is the Third Lord of the wilds, together with the two ghosts of drowning and of theft.

yi: 然而要定六神各是哪一位圣，
还必须靠八卦和五行来排；
哪一爻临在鬼上，要看得端正确实，
不要连累世人，白白花费钱财。
en: Yet to fix the seats of the sages of the six spirits,
one must still arrange them by the eight trigrams and the five phases;
look closely to see which line sits on the ghost,
and do not burden people with empty spending of money.

note.yi: 这是「总论」的第三段（编号「之三」）：官鬼所临的六神各配一串神名，体例是歌诀加解说。它和易冒「按六神断神鬼」（LY.ILL.YM.59）、黄金策「六神推鬼神」（LY.ILL.HJC.96）是同一类办法，只是名目更细；和本章前面按五行配六兽（LY.ILL.EL.30 到 EL.34）也可以对读，六神的神名与上一条（LY.ILL.EL.46）几乎全是同一批。最后一首歌诀说得最重：六神各是哪一位，还要靠八卦和五行来排、看清哪一爻临鬼，不能只凭六神一样就点名，也不要让人白白花钱——这和本章结语（LY.ILL.EL.43）、黄金策和易冒把神鬼只看作大类的做法一致。名字上的几处存疑：「花枷原」按「花枷愿」译；「止苍」疑是「上苍」（High Heaven），这里按原字音译；「承天后土皇」按字面译作「承天的后土皇」；「皇社神」按字面译作皇社（皇家的社坛）之神；「西台」没有解释，按字面译；「穿斋」按下面解说「窃盗」读作「穿窬」（挖墙洞偷东西）；「司令」解说里说就是灶神（通常写作「司命」，本书前文也写「司命」），按原字译作 Director；「螣蛇」一条「并作犯上」文字很简，「作犯」按「作出冒犯」译，「上」没有着落，这里不强译。这一段里神、鬼、星煞的名字，是吴地的民间神祇和星煞，书里没有解释，这里按字面译或音译，不作认定。
note.en: This is the third section of the 'general discourse' (numbered 'three'): each of the six spirits the Pressure line sits on is matched with a string of divine names, in the form of a verse plus a commentary. It is the same kind of method as the Yi Mao's 'judging gods and ghosts by the six spirits' (LY.ILL.YM.59) and the Huangjin Ce's 'the six spirits and gods and ghosts' (LY.ILL.HJC.96), with finer names, and can also be read against this chapter's earlier matching of the phases with the six beasts (LY.ILL.EL.30 to EL.34); the names of gods here are almost all the same set as in the previous entry (LY.ILL.EL.46). The last verse is the weightiest: which sage each of the six spirits is must still be arranged by the eight trigrams and the five phases, looking closely at which line sits on the ghost; one must not name a god from the six spirits alone, and one must not make people spend money for nothing, which agrees with this chapter's closing passage (LY.ILL.EL.43) and with the Huangjin Ce and the Yi Mao, who treat gods and ghosts only in broad kinds. Doubts about a few names: 'hua jia yuan' is translated as the vow of flowers and the cangue, the character for 'source' standing for 'vow'; 'Zhicang' is probably 'Shangcang' (High Heaven), and is transliterated as written; 'cheng tian hou tu huang' is rendered literally as 'the Sovereign Earth Emperor who receives Heaven'; 'huang she shen' is rendered literally as the spirit of the imperial altar; 'Western Terrace' has no explanation and is rendered literally; 'chuan zhai' is read as 'chuan yu' (boring through a wall to steal) from the commentary 'theft'; 'Director' (si ling) is said by the commentary to be the Kitchen God (usually written 'si ming', and this book earlier also writes 'Director of Fate'), and is translated as written; the Coiling Snake's 'and it makes an offence' is very terse: 'zuo fan' is translated as 'makes an offence', and the 'shang' is left unforced. Names of gods, spirits and stars in this passage are given by transliteration or plain rendering; they are cults and stars of the Wu region that the book does not explain, and none is identified here beyond what the book says.
